title: A-Spec
exclusionReason: No side-view camera available (standard or optional)
infotainment: Expected dual-screen layout with ASIMO OS, Google built-in. Specific screen sizes and audio brand not yet confirmed.
adasStandard: Expected to include full AcuraWatch suite plus next-gen sensor stack from ASIMO OS. Official ADAS feature list not yet published. Source: https://www.motor1.com/features/749095/acura-rsx-electric-crossover-horsepower-price-details/
adasOptional: Data unavailable: Official optional ADAS package list not published by Acura as of 2026-05-21.
rearViewCameraNotes: Data unavailable: Specific rearview camera resolution/multi-angle details not yet published. Acura standard practice includes multi-angle rear camera with dynamic guidelines on A-Spec trims.
sideViewCameraNotes: Data unavailable: Surround-view 360 camera expected based on A-Spec positioning, but not officially confirmed.
subscriptionFeatures: Data unavailable: Subscription tier details and feature gating for RSX launch not yet announced by Acura as of 2026-05-21. AcuraLink Security/Premium tiers expected to carry over. ASIMO OS may introduce new subscription-gated features.
drmNotes: First Acura with ASIMO Operating System — Honda-developed software-defined-vehicle stack with OTA updates and driver-behavior learning. Significantly more connected than the GM-based ZDX. Specific offline capability not yet documented; SDV architecture suggests some features may require periodic connectivity. AcuraLink subscription tiers continue. Source: https://recharged.com/articles/2026-acura-rsx-electric , https://www.motor1.com/features/749095/acura-rsx-electric-crossover-horsepower-price-details/
killSwitchNotes: No impaired-driving kill switch present at launch; NHTSA IIJA rule still pending. ASIMO OS includes driver-behavior learning, which may form a substrate for future passive impairment detection; no public Acura statement. Source: https://recharged.com/articles/2026-acura-rsx-electric
knownIssues: Data unavailable: First model year of brand-new platform and brand-new OS — expect first-year software issues typical of SDV launches. No owner data yet.
recalls: Data unavailable: Vehicle not yet on sale as of 2026-05-21.
stateIncentives: Federal $7,500 EV credit expired September 30, 2025 — RSX launches after expiration and is not eligible. Built in Ohio at Honda's EV Hub which previously supported NA-assembly criteria. State incentives: CA, CO ($5k-$7.5k), NJ, NY, MA may apply depending on launch timing. Source: https://www.philsmithacura.com/financing/ev-tax-credits-and-incentives.htm

subscriptionFeatures: Data unavailable: Subscription gating for Type S features (performance modes, etc.) not yet announced. AcuraLink Security/Premium expected to apply.
drmNotes: Same ASIMO OS connectivity considerations as A-Spec — Honda's first SDV with OTA updates and driver-behavior learning. AcuraLink subscriptions continue. Specific offline operation details not yet documented. Source: https://recharged.com/articles/2026-acura-rsx-electric

title: A-Spec AWD
infotainment: 11.3-inch center touchscreen with Google built-in, 11-inch digital gauge cluster, 16-speaker Bang & Olufsen audio
adasStandard: AcuraWatch suite: CMBS, Adaptive Cruise Control with Low-Speed Follow, Lane Keeping Assist, Road Departure Mitigation, Traffic Sign Recognition, Driver Attention Monitor, Blind Spot Information, Rear Cross Traffic Monitor. Source: https://www.acura.com/suvs/zdx/features
adasOptional: AcuraWatch 360+ (with A-Spec Advance pkg) adds 360-degree surround view, Front Cross Traffic Warning, Low-Speed Braking Control. Source: https://www.acura.com/suvs/zdx/features
rearViewCameraNotes: Multi-angle rearview camera with dynamic guidelines standard. Source: https://www.acura.com/suvs/zdx/features
sideViewCameraNotes: Surround-view 360-degree camera with A-Spec Advance package. No Honda LaneWatch-style side camera. Source: https://www.acura.com/suvs/zdx/features
subscriptionFeatures: AcuraLink tiers as base trim. No subscription-gated heated seats, ADAS, or performance. Google built-in 3-year trial. Source: https://www.acura.com/owners/acuralink
drmNotes: Vehicle operates fully offline. AcuraLink connected services require cellular + subscription after trial. Core functions independent of connectivity. Source: https://www.acura.com/owners/acuralink
killSwitchNotes: No impaired-driving kill switch present on 2025 MY. Driver attention monitor (camera-based) is present but advisory only. Source: https://www.acura.com/suvs/zdx/features
knownIssues: Shared GM Ultium platform issues — early infotainment freezes, occasional DC fast-charge communication errors. Limited longitudinal data due to short 18-month production run. Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Acura_ZDX
recalls: Data unavailable: confirm via https://www.nhtsa.gov/recalls for current recall status.
stateIncentives: Federal $7,500 credit expired Sept 30, 2025; ZDX qualified through that date. State programs: CA CVAP, CO $5k-$7.5k, NJ Charge Up, MA MOR-EV $3,500, NY $2,000. Source: https://www.philsmithacura.com/financing/ev-tax-credits-and-incentives.htm

title: A-Spec RWD
infotainment: 11.3-inch center touchscreen with Google built-in (Google Maps, Assistant, Play Store), 11-inch digital gauge cluster, 16-speaker Bang & Olufsen audio standard
adasStandard: AcuraWatch suite includes Collision Mitigation Braking System (CMBS), Adaptive Cruise Control with Low-Speed Follow, Lane Keeping Assist, Road Departure Mitigation, Traffic Sign Recognition, Driver Attention Monitor, Blind Spot Information, Rear Cross Traffic Monitor, Front and Rear Parking Sensors. Source: https://www.acura.com/suvs/zdx/features
adasOptional: AcuraWatch 360+ (standard on Type S, optional on A-Spec Advance) adds 360-degree visibility, Front Cross Traffic Warning, Low-Speed Braking Control. Source: https://www.acura.com/suvs/zdx/features
rearViewCameraNotes: Multi-angle rearview camera with dynamic guidelines standard. Source: https://www.acura.com/suvs/zdx/features
sideViewCameraNotes: Surround-view 360-degree camera system included with AcuraWatch 360+ (optional on A-Spec Advance, standard on Type S). No dedicated side-view camera like Honda LaneWatch. Source: https://www.acura.com/suvs/zdx/features
subscriptionFeatures: AcuraLink subscription tiers: Standard (3-year trial, then included), Security ($14.99/mo, 1-year trial), Premium ($24.99/mo or bundled with Security). Premium adds concierge, geofencing, speed alerts. Google built-in (3-year trial). When subscription lapses, vehicle continues to operate normally; only telematics/concierge features are disabled. Heated seats, ADAS, and performance features are NOT subscription-gated. Source: https://www.acura.com/owners/acuralink
drmNotes: Vehicle operates fully offline. AcuraLink connected services (remote start, vehicle finder, emergency services) require cellular connectivity and active subscription after trial period. Core driving, charging, climate, infotainment with wireless CarPlay/Android Auto work without subscription. Built on GM Ultium platform but uses Honda/Acura software stack. No documented post-sale remote feature reductions. Source: https://www.acura.com/owners/acuralink
killSwitchNotes: No impaired-driving kill switch present on 2025 MY (IIJA mandate not yet finalized by NHTSA). Driver attention monitor (camera-based) is present as part of AcuraWatch — monitors driver attention but does not disable the vehicle. Source: https://www.acura.com/suvs/zdx/features
knownIssues: As a first-year/first-generation BEV on shared GM Ultium platform, the ZDX inherits early Ultium software issues seen on Honda Prologue and Cadillac LYRIQ: occasional infotainment freezes, charging session communication errors on some DC fast chargers, and software update needs. Limited owner data given short production run. Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Acura_ZDX
recalls: Data unavailable: NHTSA recall search for 2025 Acura ZDX A-Spec RWD did not return major-impact recalls as of 2026-05-21. Some early 2024 ZDX units had a stop-sale for a software issue; confirm via https://www.nhtsa.gov/recalls before purchase.
stateIncentives: Federal $7,500 EV tax credit expired September 30, 2025; ZDX qualified through that date. State incentives vary: California CVRP retired late 2023 but Clean Vehicle Assistance Program continues; Colorado ($5,000-$7,500), New York ($2,000), New Jersey (sales tax exemption + $4,000 rebate via Charge Up NJ), Massachusetts MOR-EV ($3,500). Source: https://www.philsmithacura.com/financing/ev-tax-credits-and-incentives.htm

title: Type S
infotainment: 11.3-inch center touchscreen with Google built-in, 11-inch digital gauge cluster, 18-speaker Bang & Olufsen ELS audio system, head-up display, digital rearview mirror
adasStandard: Full AcuraWatch 360+ standard: 360-degree surround-view camera, Front Cross Traffic Warning, Low-Speed Braking Control, plus all AcuraWatch features (CMBS, ACC with Low-Speed Follow, Lane Keeping, Road Departure Mitigation, Traffic Sign Recognition, Driver Attention Monitor, Blind Spot, Rear Cross Traffic). Source: https://www.acura.com/suvs/zdx/features
adasOptional: Head-up display standard on Type S; digital rearview mirror standard. No additional ADAS optional packages.
rearViewCameraNotes: Multi-angle rearview camera plus digital rearview mirror (camera feed displayed on rearview mirror, switchable to traditional reflection). Source: https://www.acura.com/suvs/zdx/features
sideViewCameraNotes: Surround-view 360-degree camera standard. No dedicated side-view Honda LaneWatch-style camera. Source: https://www.acura.com/suvs/zdx/features
subscriptionFeatures: AcuraLink Standard/Security/Premium tiers as other trims. Type S performance features (air suspension modes, drive modes) are NOT subscription-gated. Source: https://www.acura.com/owners/acuralink
drmNotes: Vehicle operates fully offline. AcuraLink subscription needed only for telematics/concierge. Core driving, performance modes, infotainment with CarPlay/Android Auto independent of connectivity. Source: https://www.acura.com/owners/acuralink
killSwitchNotes: No impaired-driving kill switch on 2025 MY. AcuraWatch driver attention monitor (camera-based) is advisory. Source: https://www.acura.com/suvs/zdx/features
knownIssues: Shared GM Ultium platform — early infotainment glitches, occasional DC fast-charge communication errors with non-OEM stalls. Air suspension on Type S is newer technology with limited long-term data. Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Acura_ZDX
recalls: Data unavailable: confirm via https://www.nhtsa.gov/recalls for current recall status on 2025 ZDX Type S.
stateIncentives: Federal $7,500 credit expired Sept 30, 2025. Note: Type S MSRP plus options often exceeds the $80,000 MSRP cap that applied to the now-expired credit. State programs vary: CA CVAP, CO $5k-$7.5k, NJ Charge Up, NY $2,000. Source: https://www.philsmithacura.com/financing/ev-tax-credits-and-incentives.htm
